remarks:
Timeless character, generous living spaces, and thoughtful modern updates define this beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home in the Alexander School District. Set among mature trees and manicured grounds, the property offers a sense of privacy and tranquility while remaining conveniently close to shopping, dining, and everyday amenities. Inside, spacious bedrooms and baths, multiple inviting living areas, abundant natural light, and distinctive architectural details create a home that feels both refined and welcoming. Something so different than today’s cookie-cutter homes. 

Step inside to a bright, welcoming interior where hardwood flooring installed throughout in 2023 creates a warm and cohesive feel. The spacious kitchen was opened up with the removal of a wall in 2023 and features stainless steel appliances, recessed lighting, abundant storage, and beautifully restained cabinetry completed in 2026.

Designed with both everyday living and entertaining in mind, the home offers multiple gathering spaces filled with natural light. Three fireplaces, including a striking stone fireplace, create inviting focal points, while the expansive window-lined sunroom overlooks the property and provides an incredible space to relax, entertain, or simply take in the peaceful surroundings.

Recent improvements continue throughout the home with an updated laundry room with recessed lighting (2025), a new electrical breaker box, and new copper piping on the boiler (2025). The exterior received fresh paint and new shutters in 2025, followed by updated landscaping in 2026, adding to the home’s curb appeal.

Outside, enjoy a spacious lawn, mature trees, beautiful views, and plenty of room to make the property your own. A two-car attached garage and metal roof add even more convenience and value.

Full of personality and thoughtfully improved inside and out, this is a home that stands apart—offering the space, setting, and character that are increasingly hard to find.
Seller reserves the right to set a deadline. Join us for an open house Saturday, October 10th from 11am to 1pm.
